decisions.title: v0 wedge is OpenFOAM-based CFD Trust Workbench, not a full STAR-CCM+ clone
decisions.rationale:
Building a full CFD workbench in one shot reliably fails. The first credible
thing to build is a machine-auditable trust contract around a single canonical
benchmark, with the solver layer mockable so the rest of the loop is exercised.

decisions.title: flat_plate_rans_sst is the first sample case
decisions.rationale:
Flat plate steady-RANS with k-omega SST is the most-studied verification
case; reference data is well-known, geometry is trivial, and the case
forces us to define every contract section (mesh / BC / QoI / reference).

decisions.title: Phase 0 may use mocked solver execution; must be clearly labeled
decisions.rationale:
Real OpenFOAM integration is not the wedge; a mocked solver gate lets us
exercise the rest of the trust loop while making the mock impossible to
hide. Every mocked trust_report must include solver_execution: mocked and
validation_status: not_validated.

decisions.title: First UI is cockpit + trust report, not a full CFD workbench
decisions.rationale:
A 1-minute cockpit + a per-case trust report is enough UI for Phase 0.
Anything else slides into "STAR-CCM+ clone" scope.

blockers.title: Real OpenFOAM execution not implemented
blockers.description:
Phase 0 mocks the solver layer. Until a real OpenFOAM adapter exists,
no trust_report can claim validation.

blockers.title: Reference data for flat_plate_rans_sst not finalized
blockers.description:

A canonical published dataset must be adopted before any validation claim.
unblocks: First true PASS instead of MOCKED

blockers.title: Negative test directories are scaffold only
blockers.description:
